title: The source principal completion orthogonal criterion
statement: For an essentially small site J, a commutative coefficient ring R and a nonzerodivisor r generating I, an object K of the derived category of R-module sheaves is derived I-complete if and only if every morphism from any object on which r acts invertibly to K is zero.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; derived completion by the derived inverse limit of finite reductions

proof.text: Each finite reduction is killed by a power of the generator, so maps from generator-invertible objects and their shifts vanish. The homotopy limit is therefore right orthogonal. Conversely take the completion augmentation; its cone has invertible generator by the principal Koszul triangle. Orthogonality makes this cone zero and the augmentation invertible. These two implications are already proved in source Complete/Principal.lean.
